fr.name: Médoc
fr.description: Huit appellations du Médoc sur la rive gauche de la Garonne : deux sous-régionales (Médoc et Haut-Médoc) et six communales (Saint-Estèphe, Pauillac, Saint-Julien, Moulis-en-Médoc, Listrac-Médoc, Margaux), partageant plus de 16 000 hectares ; le classement de 1855 s'y applique.
fr.sourceTitle: Les Vins du Médoc — Les appellations médocaines（法语官方页）

data.areaNote: 官方原文（Conseil des Vins du Médoc 官网「Les appellations médocaines」页）："les 8 appellations médocaines dont 2 sous-régionales (Médoc et Haut-Médoc) et 6 communales (Saint-Estèphe, Pauillac, Saint-Julien, Moulis-en-Médoc, Listrac-Médoc, Margaux), se partagent plus de 16 000 hectares d'exception." 因官方用的是下限表述「plus de 16 000 hectares」（逾 16 000 公顷）而非统计精确值，按硬规矩不把下限当精确面积写入 areaHectares，留 null 并在此照录原文。
data.productionNote: Conseil des Vins du Médoc 官方站在本次可抓取的页面未给出产量数字（实测其正文由前端渲染，WordPress REST 返回的各产区分页 content 为空字符串），故产量留空。
data.producersNote: Conseil des Vins du Médoc 官方站设分级与名录栏目：Les Grands Crus Classés en 1855（1855 年列级庄）、Les Crus Bourgeois（中级庄）、Les Crus Artisans（工匠庄）、Caves Coopératives（合作社酒窖）、Les autres crus；本次未取得酒庄总家数的官方数字，故 producersNote 不做家数断言。
data.grapeNote: 官方站设有独立品种页「Une palette de cépages」（https://www.medoc-bordeaux.com/appellations-2/cepages/），但该页正文由前端渲染，本次 curl 与 WordPress REST 均未取到正文文本，故不在此写具体品种构成；可引用的官方表述只有八个产区的结构与面积（见 areaNote）。1855 年分级所涉村镇即 commune 字段所列六个村庄级产区。
data.soil: 官方站设有独立页「Climat et sol」（https://www.medoc-bordeaux.com/appellations-2/climat-et-sol/），本次同样未取到正文文本（前端渲染 + REST 空 content），故 soil 不做成土断言，留待复核。
data.climate: 官方未在本次可抓取正文中给出气候数字。
data.geography: 官方原文（Les appellations médocaines 页）："Sur la Rive gauche de la Garonne, les 8 appellations médocaines [...] se partagent plus de 16 000 hectares d'exception."（位于加龙河左岸）。官方另称 "Comme l'ensemble des appellations d'origine contrôlée, les huit appellations médocaines sont soumises à des conditions de production rigoureuses qui en assurent la qualité et la typicité."
data.notes: AOC 设立年份未在本次可抓取官方页给出，appellationCreated 留 null（1855 年分级是历史事件而非 AOC 设立年，故不写入该字段）。官方站另设 Guide Destination Vignobles en Médoc、Route des vins du Médoc 与 Blog「La vie du Médoc」。重要限制：medoc-bordeaux.com 正文由前端渲染，curl 取回的页面只剩 cookie 声明，WordPress REST（/wp-json/wp/v2/pages）32 个页面的 content.rendered 除总览页 1775 外均为空字符串，因此该产区多数细节字段本轮无法取得。
data.officialQuote: Sur la Rive gauche de la Garonne, les 8 appellations médocaines dont 2 sous-régionales (Médoc et Haut-Médoc) et 6 communales (Saint-Estèphe, Pauillac, Saint-Julien, Moulis-en-Médoc, Listrac-Médoc, Margaux), se partagent plus de 16 000 hectares d'exception.

producerDirectory.name: Conseil des Vins du Médoc — Les châteaux / Crus（列级庄、中级庄、工匠庄、合作社分类入口）
producerDirectory.note: 官方站 Crus 栏目下分 Les Grands Crus Classés en 1855、Les Crus Bourgeois、Les Crus Artisans、Caves Coopératives、Les autres crus 五个名录入口；另有 Guide Destination Vignobles en Médoc（/visiter/guide-destination-vignobles-medoc/）与 Route des vins du Médoc。本次未能解析出逐家含地址/官网字段的条目（站点前端渲染），故家数未知。

data.sourceTitle: Austrian Wine Marketing（Österreich Wein Marketing，austrianwine.com）— Wine-growing regions: Burgenland 及子页 Eisenberg；Wein Burgenland（weinburgenland.at）

de.name: Burgenland
de.description: Österreichs östlichstes Bundesland, vom heißen pannonischen Klima geprägt; führende Rotweinregion Österreichs mit Blaufränkisch als Leitsorte, dazu Blauer Zweigelt und Sankt Laurent; DAC-Familie Mittelburgenland (Jg. 2005), Leithaberg, Eisenberg (seit 2009), Neusiedlersee, Rosalia (2018) und Ruster Ausbruch (2020).
de.sourceTitle: Austrian Wine Marketing — Burgenland（德语/英文官方页，本次经搜索索引取得正文）

data.areaNote: Austrian Wine Marketing（Österreich Wein Marketing）官方 Burgenland 页的 "Area under vine [ha]" 为前端 JS 载入的图表，本次直连被 bunny.net 安全服务拦截（HTTP 403，返回 "Establishing a secure connection / Performance & security by bunny.net" 页），未能取得官方公顷数；Wein Burgenland 官方站（weinburgenland.at）当前为改版占位页，只列六个葡萄酒产区名，无面积。故 areaHectares 留 null，不以第三方数字替代。
data.productionNote: 官方未在本次可取得正文中给出产量数字，留空。
data.producersNote: Wein Burgenland 官方站本次为改版占位页（原文："Aktuell gestalten wir unseren digitalen Auftritt neu, um Ihnen die Vielfalt und Qualität unserer Weinbaugebiete noch anschaulicher zu präsentieren."），未提供生产者名录或家数；Austrian Wine Marketing 的 Burgenland 页亦未给家数。故留空。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Austrian Wine Marketing，Burgenland 页）："Blaufränkisch" 为该区旗舰红品种（"the best possible conditions for Blaufränkisch grapes, which produce red wines with the finest minerality and incomparable elegance"）；"To the east of Lake Neusiedl, Blauer Zweigelt prevails, producing powerful, juicy reds – although Blaufränkisch and Sankt Laurent also manage to yield outstanding results."；白品种 "With its limestone and slate soils, the eastern slope of the Leitha Range provides a unique terroir for complex white wines – particularly for Pinot Blanc and Chardonnay, but also for Grüner Veltliner – as well as for reds produced from Blaufränkisch."；甜酒品种 "Welschriesling attains exceptional levels of expressiveness in this style, as do other grape varieties like Chardonnay, Scheurebe and Traminer."
data.soil: 官方原文（Austrian Wine Marketing，Burgenland 页 Geology 段）："Burgenland is made up of the Styrian and Pannonian Basins, the Austroalpine nappes and the Penninic zone. [...] Coarse-grained sandy gravels with varying carbonate content, originating from the courses of the former Danube, represent more than 60% of the soils here. The Seewinkel gravels in particular are found in about one third of all vineyards in the region. [...] A good third of the region's vineyards are located on the basin's sedimentary deposits from the Neogene. These vary greatly in composition [...] They range from clays [...] in Mittelburgenland, to hard Leitha limestone. [...] these rocks are very diverse and include dolomite and limestone, limestone schist, clayey schist and mica schist, along with different forms of gneiss, amphibolite and serpentinite."
data.climate: 官方原文（Austrian Wine Marketing）："Burgenland, the easternmost of Austria's federal states, is influenced by the hot, continental Pannonian climate and produces the most opulent and authoritative red wines in Austria, along with complex whites and extraordinarily fine sweet wines."；Eisenberg 子产区专页："This is where the continental and Mediterranean climates meet, and where the East transitions to the South."
data.geography: 官方原文（Austrian Wine Marketing，Eisenberg 子产区页）："The southernmost part of Burgenland is home to the state's purest and most natural viticultural landscape, stretching between Rechnitz in the north and Güssing in the south."；"The Eisenberg hill – after which the region is named – has great historic significance and is considered the viticultural epicentre of the region, alongside Deutsch-Schützen Weinberg."；"The steep hillsides are predominantly characterised by slate soils"，坡脚 "highly ferrous loam"。Seewinkel 一带官方描述为 "numerous small lakes, or 'Zicklacken'" 造成高湿度。
data.notes: Anbaugebiet 法定设立年份未取得，appellationCreated 留 null。DAC 体系时间线（官方原文）："Following the release of Burgenland's first regionally typical wine (Mittelburgenland DAC, with the 2005 vintage), other regions have also achieved DAC recognition: Leithaberg DAC, Eisenberg DAC and Neusiedlersee DAC. Since then, the former Großlage (large collective vineyard site) of Rosalia was awarded its own DAC in 2018, together with the Ruster Ausbruch DAC in 2020, making Burgenland's DAC family finally complete."；Eisenberg 页另明确 "The typical Blaufränkisch from southern Burgenland has been marketed under the name of Eisenberg DAC since 2009." 采集限制：austrianwine.com 与 oesterreichwein.at 直连均返回 403（bunny.net 安全拦截），本条目正文经由搜索索引取得该官方页内容；Wein Burgenland 站（weinburgenland.at / burgenland.wine）无法提供数据（改版占位 / DNS 解析失败）。Eisenberg 子产区页另称该区 Blaufränkisch 面积 168 ha（"Blaufränkisch [...] 168"，为官方页图表数字，本次标注为子产区级、非全州口径）。
data.officialQuote: Burgenland, the easternmost of Austria's federal states, is influenced by the hot, continental Pannonian climate and produces the most opulent and authoritative red wines in Austria, along with complex whites and extraordinarily fine sweet wines.

de.name: Pfalz
de.description: Zweitgrößtes deutsches Weinbaugebiet: 23.640 ha Rebfläche (2025), davon 5.883 ha Riesling, zwei Bereiche (Mittelhaardt-Deutsche Weinstraße und Südliche Weinstraße), 25 Großlagen und über 300 Einzellagen, 85 km und 130 Weinorte; Böden überwiegend Lehm, Klima sonnenreich bei 11 °C Jahresmittel.
de.sourceTitle: Deutsches Weininstitut — Anbaugebiet Pfalz（德语官方页）

data.areaNote: 官方原文（Deutsches Weininstitut 官网 Anbaugebiet Pfalz 页数据块）："23.640 ha Rebfläche (2025)"，同页 "5.883 ha Riesling"。英文镜像页（Wines of Germany）同口径："Vineyard area 2025: 23,640 ha · 2 districts · 25 collective vineyard sites · 300+ individual sites"。单一官方来源，无冲突。
data.productionNote: 官方（Deutsches Weininstitut / Wines of Germany）给出的是面积与品种结构而非产量绝对数："Grape varieties 2025 [white 69% · red 31%]"（白 69%、红 31%）；官方未在本页给出 hl 或吨产量，故不做换算，productionNote 如实记录品种结构。
data.producersNote: 产区推广机构为 Pfalzwein e.V.（官方页联系信息：67433 Neustadt an der Weinstraße）。Deutsches Weininstitut 设 Vinothek 酒庄库，本次抓到 3 条带酒庄名的条目（Weingut Dr. Bürklin-Wolf e.K.（Wachenheim）、Weingut Fritz Walter（Niederhorbach）、Weingut Karl-Heinz Gaul（Grünstadt/Pfalz）、Weingut Holz-Weisbrodt（Weisenheim am Berg）、Weingut Sturm、Weingut Kreutzenberger）；产区酒庄总家数官方未在本页给出。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Deutsches Weininstitut）："Grape varieties 2025 [white 69% · red 31%]: Riesling, Dornfelder, Grauburgunder, Müller-Thurgau, Spätburgunder as well as Portugieser, Weißburgunder, Kerner and Chardonnay"；官方另标 Riesling 面积 "5.883 ha Riesling"（Riesling cultivation）。
data.soil: 官方原文（Wines of Germany）："Soil types: Loam is prevalent, often in a mixture with other soil types, such as loess, chalk, clay, colored sandstone or sand"。
data.climate: 官方原文（Wines of Germany）："Climate: Many hours of sunshine, average temperature: 11°C"。
data.geography: 官方原文："Die Pfalz ist mit 23.640 Hektar Rebfläche das zweitgrößte deutsche Weinbaugebiet und setzt sich aus den beiden Bereichen Mittelhaardt-Deutsche Weinstraße und Südliche Weinstraße zusammen."；"Auf 85 Kilometern verknüpft sie die 130 Weinorte des Anbaugebiets zwischen Bockenheim und Schweigen an der Grenze zum Elsass miteinander."；官方并称该区拥有世界最大的葡萄酒节（Bad Dürkheim）与最早最知名的葡萄酒之路 Deutsche Weinstraße。
data.notes: Anbaugebiet 法定设立年份未在本次可抓取官方页给出，appellationCreated 留 null。（德国 13 个 Anbaugebiete 的现行划界与 1971 年酒法相关，但本次未取得可引用的官方设立年份表述，故不写。）Pfalz 官方推广站 pfalzwein.de 本次 DNS 解析失败（curl 000），产区口径以 Deutsches Weininstitut（deutscheweine.de，德语）与 Wines of Germany（winesofgermany.com，英文镜像）为准。
data.officialQuote: Die Pfalz ist mit 23.640 Hektar Rebfläche das zweitgrößte deutsche Weinbaugebiet und setzt sich aus den beiden Bereichen Mittelhaardt-Deutsche Weinstraße und Südliche Weinstraße zusammen.

it.name: Soave
it.description: Zona collinare a est di Verona; DOC dal 1968 (DPR 21 agosto 1968), con Soave Classico riservato ai comuni di Soave e Monteforte d'Alpone; circa 6.500 ettari e circa 3.000 tra viticoltori e produttori; uvaggio minimo 70% Garganega con 30% Trebbiano di Soave o Chardonnay; tipologie Soave DOC, Soave Classico DOC, Soave Superiore DOCG e Recioto di Soave DOCG (primo DOCG del Veneto).
it.sourceTitle: Consorzio Tutela Vini Soave — Consorzio / Disciplinare（意语官方页）

data.areaNote: Consorzio Tutela Vini Soave 官方站（ilsoave.com）在本次抓取的 Storia / I Suoli / Le Uve / Consorzio / Disciplinare / Vini 各页未给出公顷数；唯一可引用的面积口径来自 Le Uve 页："Soave ha circa 6.500 ettari coltivati a vite da circa 3.000 tra viticoltori e produttori."（约 6 500 公顷，官方用 circa 约数）。因是明显约数且未给统计年，按硬规矩不把约数写成精确面积，areaHectares 留 null 并在此照录原文。
data.productionNote: 官方未在本次抓取页面公布产量（hl/瓶）数字，留空；官方给出的可引用规模口径为 "circa 6.500 ettari [...] da circa 3.000 tra viticoltori e produttori"。
data.producersNote: 官方名录页（Produttori Soave）给出分类计数："Doc (97)"（97 家 DOC 生产者）、"Soave (19)"、"Colognola ai Colli (9)"、"Castelcerino di Soave (1)"、"Verona (7)"，并列出 Cantina di Colognola ai Colli、Collis Cantina Veneta、Collis Veneto Wine Group、Cantine di Verona、Cottini 1925 等条目名。官方 Le Uve 页给出全产区种植者口径："circa 3.000 tra viticoltori e produttori"（约 3 000 名种植者与生产者）。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Consorzio 页）："I vini Soave DOC sono prodotti con un minimo di 70% di garganega e il 30% di trebbiano di Soave o chardonnay. Entro il 30% è consentito un massimo del 5% di altre uve bianche tradizionalmente coltivate nella zona."；Recioto di Soave DOCG 同口径 "almeno il 70% di garganega e il 30% di trebbiano di soave"。官方 Le Uve 页另述 Garganega 与 Trebbiano di Soave 两个品种（"Il Trebbiano di Soave è una varietà delicata a bassa resa, che è stata lentamente abbandonata a favore della più vigorosa garganega. Oggi il Trebbiano di Soave sta ritornando, anche se rappresenta ancora solo una piccola percentuale dei vigneti piantati nel Soave Classico."）。
data.agingNote: 官方原文（Consorzio 页）：Soave DOC 可分静止酒与微起泡酒（"possono essere prodotti sia come vini fermi che frizzanti"）；Soave Superiore DOCG "deve mostrare un colore più dorato, e gli aromi hanno più profondità con note floreali. Il sapore è più pieno e più intenso."，并区分 Superiore 与 Superiore Riserva；Recioto di Soave DOCG "può essere prodotto sia come vino naturale che frizzante"，"La resa massima delle uve in vino per un Recioto di Soave fermo è del 40%, del 42% per lo spumante"，"Il livello di alcol deve raggiungere un minimo del 14%"，且 "È il vino di as[ciutto]"（用风干葡萄，"garganega air-dried over several months before pressing, with yields which cannot exceed 40%"）。
data.soil: 官方原文（I Suoli 页）："L'area storica di Soave, nota come Soave Classico, è una serie di colline e valli formate da una trasformazione geologica iniziata oltre 90 milioni di anni fa."；Storia 页补充："Oggi sappiamo che il terreno di origine vulcanica ha molte caratteristiche uniche che lo rendono estremamente fertile e ideale per l'agricoltura."、"l'ingegnere Battista Perez studia e descrive l'area di produzione di Soave. Su queste colline la vite trova un terreno scuro, ricco di silicio e ideale per la coltivazione della vite."、"Giovanni Del Sie è stato il primo a definire le caratteristiche principali della terra di Soave, formata da rocce vulcaniche come il basalto che formano un terreno fertile."
data.climate: 官方未在本次抓取页面给出气候数字原句；官方设有逐年 Vendemmie（年份报告）页，逐年份描述气象与采收（如 2017 年 "L'annata 2017 può essere definita una delle più complesse degli ultimi 30 anni."、2018 年 "temperature leggermente superiori alla media"），可作年份依据但不构成本轮气候字段的稳定口径。
data.geography: 官方原文（Consorzio 页）："La zona di produzione del Soave è situata nella parte orientale delle colline della provincia di Verona."；"La zona comprende una parte o tutte le terre appartenenti ai comuni di Soave, Monteforte, San Martino B.A., Lavagno, Mezzane, Caldiero, Colognola, Illasi, Cazzano, San Bonifacio, Roncà, Montecchia e S. Giovanni Ilarione."；Soave Classico 的地理定义（Disciplinare 页原文）："The use of the specification 'Classico' with the designation 'Soave' is reserved for the product made from grapes harvested and vinified in the municipalities of Soave and Monteforte d'Alpone, ie. the oldest, original 'classic' zone."；另 "I Colli Scaligeri formano una sorta di ferro di cavallo attorno al Soave Classico"。
data.notes: 法定时间线（官方原文，Consorzio 页）："Nel 1931, Soave fu uno dei primi vini ad essere dichiarato Vino Italiano Nativo per decreto reale. Le linee guida di produzione moderne sono state stabilite quando Soave ha ricevuto lo status di protezione sotto la DOC – Denominazione di Origine Controllata nel 1968 (DPR 21 agosto 1968)."（appellationCreated 取 1968 = DOC 设立年；1931 年为王室法令「本土葡萄酒」认定）。官方 Disciplinare 页另述："Recioto di Soave was the first wine to obtain DOCG status in the Veneto"；2015 年起新植园只允许特定树形且每公顷不得少于 3,300 株（"As of 2015, new plantings may only be trained according to the following methods: single or double Espalier; single, unilateral Pergola; or uni- or bi-lateral small Veronese Pergola (pergoletta veronese). In every case, there must be no less than 3,300 vines per hectare."）。质量金字塔为 Soave DOC、Soave Classico DOC、Soave Superiore DOCG、Recioto di Soave DOCG。官方并称其历史性合作体系获 FAO-GIAHS 国际认可（Le Uve 页："Il suo virtuoso e storico sistema di cooperazione [...] è riconosciuto al livello internazionale dalla FAO – GIAHS."）。
data.officialQuote: I vini Soave DOC sono prodotti con un minimo di 70% di garganega e il 30% di trebbiano di Soave o chardonnay. Entro il 30% è consentito un massimo del 5% di altre uve bianche tradizionalmente coltivate nella zona.

data.sourceTitle: Consorzio per la Tutela dei Vini DOC Bolgheri e DOC Bolgheri Sassicaia 官方站（bolgheridoc.com）— Territorio / Vini / Consorziati / Bolgheri DOC / Storia

it.name: Bolgheri
it.description: DOC istituita con il disciplinare del 1983, 1.379 ettari vitati e 78 soci (99,1% della denominazione); territorio coincidente con il Comune di Castagneto Carducci (LI) esclusa la fascia costiera a ovest della Via Aurelia, altitudine 10–380 m, clima con 250 giorni di vento e 15,5 °C di media annua, 27 tipi di suolo individuati dallo studio di zonazione concluso nel 2006; rossi a base di Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot e Cabernet Franc, bianchi a base di Vermentino.
it.sourceTitle: Consorzio Bolgheri — Bolgheri DOC / Territorio / Vini（意语官方页）

data.areaNote: 官方原文（Consorzio 官网「Bolgheri DOC — Dati della denominazione」数据块）："Superficie Vitata: 1.379 ettari"，同块 "Produttori del Consorzio: 78"、"Rappresentatività del Consorzio: 99.1%"。单一官方来源，无冲突。
data.productionNote: 官方在「Dati della denominazione」下设有 "Produzione Imbottigliata"、"Superfici Vitate DOC"、"Incidenza Produttiva"、"Età Vigneti" 等图表栏目，数值以图形式呈现，本次未解析出可引用的绝对数，故产量留空；官方另给出可引用的结构信息："buona parte del vigneto Bolgheri sta entrando nella piena maturità produttiva proprio nel presente, avendo un'età media di circa 15 anni."（葡萄园平均藤龄约 15 年）。
data.producersNote: 官方原文（Bolgheri DOC 页 Dati della denominazione）："Produttori del Consorzio: 78"、"Rappresentatività del Consorzio: 99.1%"；官方全文："Ad oggi, nel 2026, il Consorzio è formato da 78 soci produttori i cui vigneti rappresentano il 99% del totale. Quasi tutte le aziende del territorio svolgono tutte le fasi produttive, dalla vigna all'imbottigliamento." 名录页 Consorziati 逐家列出 78 家 Soci DOC Bolgheri 与 1 家 Soci DOC Bolgheri Sassicaia（Tenuta San Guido），多数条目带 Proprietà、地址、电话、邮箱与官网。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Vini 页）："I rossi di Bolgheri sono di norma basati sul taglio Cabernet (Sauvignon e Franc) e Merlot, spesso accompagnati da Syrah, Petit Verdot e in rari casi da Sangiovese."；白品种 "Nel caso dei bianchi normalmente l'uva di riferimento è il Vermentino, molto spesso vinificato in purezza, ma anche tagliato con altre uve, tra cui vale la pena citare le due più importanti, ovvero Sauvignon Blanc e Viognier."；桃红 "se questi tradizionalmente erano a base Sangiovese oggi vengono ottenuti con le medesime uve utilizzate per i rossi"。
data.agingNote: 官方原文（Vini 页，各类型法定要求）：Bolgheri Rosso — "Resa Massima 90 quintali per ettaro"、"Affinamento: Un anno. È commerciabile il 1° settembre successivo alla vendemmia."；Bolgheri Superiore — "Resa Massima 80 quintali per ettaro"、"Affinamento: Due anni di cui almeno uno in legno. [...] commerciabile dal 1° gennaio."；Bolgheri Sassicaia — "Uve: 80% Minimo Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Uve complementari (Cabernet Franc)"、"Resa Massima 70 quintali per ettaro"、"Affinamento: Due anni di cui almeno 18 mesi in barriques da 225 litri."；Recioto 类的法定最低酒精度与糖分要求未在本页给出。
data.soil: 官方原文（Territorio — Suolo）："A livello geologico Bolgheri ha una doppia origine, da un lato marina, dovuta al ritiro del mare, dall'altra alluvionale, legata ai depositi che i corsi d'acqua provenienti dalle colline hanno formato nel corso delle ere."；"è stato approntato a metà anni '90 un importante studio di zonazione, conclusosi nel 2006, guidato dal Prof. Attilio Scienza. Sono stati individuati 27 tipi diversi di suoli"；"nella maggior parte dei casi i terreni di Bolgheri sono sabbioso-argillosi, alcalini, profondi e caratterizzati da uno scheletro ben presente, nel quale è spesso possibile notare anche in superficie la presenza di frammenti fossili quali piccole conchiglie"。
data.climate: 官方原文（Territorio — Clima）："I venti, soprattutto quelli che arrivano dal mare canalizzati dall'Arcipelago toscano, rinfrescano per la maggior parte dell'anno la zona, portandola ad avere una temperatura media annua di 15,5°, più bassa di circa un grado rispetto alle altre zone della costa."；"La presenza frequente dei venti, almeno 250 giorni l'anno, ha anche un altro effetto molto importante a livello di salute delle piante, in quanto limita la presenza di umidità nei vigneti"；"Le precipitazioni sono nell'ordine dei 600 ml annui, ben distribuiti durante i mesi"。
data.geography: 官方原文（Territorio — Geografia）："Il territorio entro cui è consentita la produzione dei vini DOC Bolgheri coincide coi confini amministrativi del Comune di Castagneto Carducci, in provincia di Livorno, ad eccezione della fascia litoranea collocata a Ovest della Via Aurelia."；"Le dimensioni del territorio sono contenute: la distanza nord-sud è di circa 13 km, mentre quella est-ovest circa 7 km. L'altitudine dei vigneti è variabile e spazia dai 10 ai 380 m sul livello del mare."
data.notes: 法定时间线（官方原文，Vini — Disciplinari）："La produzione dei vini DOC Bolgheri trova il suo primo fondamento normativo nel disciplinare del 1983, firmato il primo agosto di quell'anno dal Presidente della Repubblica Italiana Sandro Pertini. In questa prima versione è contemplata la produzione solo dei vini bianchi e rosati."；1994 年修订 "viene sancita e riconosciuta ufficialmente l'identità [...] Due sono le tipologie previste: il Bolgheri Rosso DOC ed il Bolgheri Superiore DOC. Contestualmente viene anche definita l'allora sottozona Bolgheri Sassicaia DOC."；2011 年修订允许 "l'uso libero delle tre varietà principali del territorio: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot e Cabernet Franc"（此前只能做混酿）；2013 年 Bolgheri Sassicaia DOC 从子产区升为独立法定产区。Consorzio 官方原文："Il Consorzio nasce nel gennaio 1995 a pochi mesi dalla nascita del disciplinare dei vini rossi a fine 1994."、"Nel 2014 il Consorzio ottiene il riconoscimento di massimo livello dal Ministero, ricevendo l'incarico a operare erga omnes"。法定产区设立年份取 1983（首个 disciplinare 年）。
data.officialQuote: Il Consorzio per la Tutela dei vini DOC Bolgheri e DOC Bolgheri Sassicaia è il Consorzio di Tutela ufficialmente riconosciuto dal Ministero delle Politiche Agricole, Alimentari, Forestali e del Turismo quale unico organismo preposto alla Promozione, la Protezione e Gestione delle due denominazioni interessate.

producerDirectory.name: Consorzio Bolgheri — Consorziati（78 家 Soci DOC Bolgheri + 1 家 Soci DOC Bolgheri Sassicaia，逐家含地址/电话/邮箱/官网）

data.sourceTitle: CRDOP Jumilla（Consejo Regulador de la DOP Jumilla）官方站 — El viñedo / Estadísticas / Our Vines / Our Grape Varieties / Where We Are / Wine Profiles

es.name: Jumilla
es.description: DOP del sureste español repartida entre Murcia y Albacete (7 municipios), Monastrell como variedad reina (70% del viñedo), viñedos de secano entre 320 y 1.000 m, más de 3.000 horas de sol al año y suelos calizos; 1.400 viticultores y 38 bodegas certificadas.
es.sourceTitle: CRDOP Jumilla — El viñedo（西语官方页）

data.areaNote: 官方同站出现三处不同口径，无法归一，故面积留 null：①「El viñedo」页 "La superficie de viñedo inscrito de la Denominación de Origen Protegida Jumilla es de aproximadamente 22.000 hectáreas de viñedo"（约 22 000 ha，约数）；②「Estadísticas」页 "cuenta con 20.000 hectáreas inscritas" 且 2025 年分市镇明细表合计 "20332 Ha"；③「Our Vines」英文页 "The vineyard area registered in the Jumilla DOP in 2023 forms a total of approximately 20,000 hectares"。22 000 与 20 000/20 332 差幅显著且无口径说明，按硬规矩不做取舍，留 null 并记 discrepancies。
data.productionNote: 官方原文（Estadísticas 页）："En la campaña 2024/2025 se han comercializado un total de 18,7 millones de botellas, siendo el 41% en mercado interior y el 59% de exportación."（2024/2025 年度共销售 1 870 万瓶，内销 41%、出口 59%）。此为商业销售量口径，非葡萄产量。
data.producersNote: 官方两处口径：①Estadísticas 页 "Agrupa a 1.400 viticultores y cuenta con 38 bodegas certificadas"（1 400 名种植者、38 家认证酒庄）；②Where We Are 英文页 "Currently, the region's 42 wineries encompass a spectrum of small family enterprises, larger family-owned concerns, and a couple of prominent corporate entities, complemented by the presence of six cooperatives."（42 家酒庄，含 6 家合作社）。38 为「已认证」、42 为「酒庄总数」，口径不同故并列照录，不做推算。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Estadísticas 页）："el 95% corresponde a las variedades tintas autorizadas y el 5% a las variedades de uva blancas. Del total de viñedo, el 70% es de la variedad reina de la DOP Jumilla, la uva Monastrell."（法定红品种占 95%、白品种 5%；Monastrell 占总葡萄园 70%）。英文品种页补充："After Monastrell, the main red varieties grown in Jumilla are Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon and Garnacha Tintorera. Garnacha (Grenache), Tempranillo, Merlot and Petit Verdot are also grown in smaller proportions."；白品种 "The traditional Airén [...] fell out of favour with some Jumilla wineries, which opted for the more aromatic Sauvignon Blanc."。
data.agingNote: 官方酒款页区分 Jumilla red（未过桶/轻过桶与橡木桶/大桶陈年两类）、Jumilla rosé（主要用 Monastrell，部分酒庄做 Garnacha 桃红）、natural sweet wines and fortified reds（含 Monastrell Dulce，类波特风格的加烈甜红）。
data.soil: 官方原文（Our Vines 页）："Jumilla's deep, cool, rocky, limestone soils, which cover most of the region, enables the vines to find moisture deep underground and survive without irrigation."（深厚、凉爽、多石的石灰质土壤覆盖大部分产区）；El viñedo 页称种植以旱作与灌木式（vaso）整形为主。
data.climate: 官方原文（El viñedo 页）："Es un clima soleado, con una luminosidad muy alta, con 3.000 horas de sol al año, y vientos constantes que limpian el viñedo [...] siendo la humedad relativa media anual del 60,4 %."；Our Vines 页："With less than 300mm annual rainfall and over 3,000 hours of sunshine a year, the Jumilla wine region offers near-perfect conditions for organic vine-growing"。
data.geography: 官方原文（Where We Are 页）："A 3 hour-drive south from Madrid and less than one hour by car from Alicante airport, the Jumilla DOP stretches from the extreme south-east of the province of Albacete down through Murcia as far as the border with Alicante province. From north to south, it passes through the villages of Montealegre del Castillo, Fuente-Alamo, Ontur, Hellín, Albatana and Tobarra before entering the northern part of Murcia province, which includes the municipality of Jumilla [...] and the enchanting Carche Valley"。El viñedo 页：种植海拔 "desde los 320 metros hasta los 1.000 metros"；"más de 20% de la viña tiene más de 30 años, e incluye unas 1.000 hectáreas de viña plantada a pie franco"（逾 20% 葡萄藤超 30 年，约 1 000 ha 为未嫁接自根苗）；"más del 75% de la superficie certificada"（有机认证面积逾 75%）；Our Vines 页称约 79% 为旱作。
data.notes: DOP（原 DO）设立年份未在本次可抓取官方页给出（历史页只叙述腓尼基人引入葡萄种植、罗马人与摩尔人时期，未给法定设立年），appellationCreated 留 null。官方历史页给出可核实的考古线索：Coimbra del Barranco Ancho 出土、约 2 400 年前、带葡萄串纹样的金耳饰。
data.officialQuote: La superficie de viñedo inscrito de la Denominación de Origen Protegida Jumilla es de aproximadamente 22.000 hectáreas de viñedo. La zona de producción de la DOP comprende territorios de notable altitud, extendiéndose las plantaciones de viñedo desde los 320 metros hasta los 1.000 metros.

producerDirectory.name: Nuestras Bodegas / Ver bodegas de Jumilla certificadas（认证酒庄名录）
producerDirectory.note: 官方 Estadísticas 页给出 38 家认证酒庄与 1 400 名种植者的规模，并提供「Ver bodegas de Jumilla certificadas」入口；英文站另有 OUR WINERIES 与互动地图（Where We Are 页 "Learn more about Jumilla's wineries using our interactive map"）。名录为前端渲染，本次未解析出逐家含地址/官网字段的条目。 （逐家详情页 /bodegas_cpt/<slug>/ 给出登记名、Municipio、门牌地址、电话与邮箱）

data.locationPrecision: 参考点：取本产区内已定位酒庄「Bodega Casa Rojo」的实体点位作为产区显示点。**这不是产区法定边界，也不代表产区范围**；法定边界文件未取得。酒庄点位精度与来源见该酒庄记录的 locationPrecision / locationSourceURL。

pt.name: Dão
pt.description: Região Demarcada desde 18 de Setembro de 1908 (a primeira região portuguesa de vinhos não licorosos demarcada e regulamentada), solos graníticos com afloramentos xistosos, altitude média 400–500 m, clima temperado frio e chuvoso no Inverno; castas DOC: Touriga Nacional, Encruzado, Alfrocheiro, Jaen.
pt.sourceTitle: CVR Dão — Região Demarcada / Terroir（葡语官方页）

data.areaNote: CVR Dão 官方站在本次可抓取的 Região Demarcada / Terroir / Castas / Facts and Figures 页均未给出葡萄园公顷数（Facts and Figures 为可下载 PDF，本轮未解析），故 areaHectares 留 null，不引用未核实数字。
data.productionNote: 官方 Observatório Estatístico 页仅提供报表入口（"Cadastro Vitícola 2026"、"Produção Declarada - Campanha 2025/2026"、"Introdução do Consumo" 2026 年 1/2/3/5/6/7/8 月、"Relatório de Análise Setorial | Global - IVV Ano 2025"、"| Por Região - IVV Ano 2025"），数值在 PDF/XLS 内，本轮未解析，故产量留空。
data.producersNote: 官方 Rota dos Vinhos do Dão 页原文："A Rota dos Vinhos do Dão [...] É constituída por 48 aderentes dispersos pelo território da Região do Dão."（酒路成员 48 家，为酒路加入者而非全部生产者）。官方另设「Agentes Económicos」（经济主体）与「Produtores」入口；产区全部生产者家数未取得。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Castas 页）："As castas destinadas à produção dos vinhos DOC Dão são as seguintes:"，红品种 Alfrocheiro / Tinta Bastarda、Jaen / Mencia、Touriga Nacional、Tinta-Carvalha、Touriga-Fêmea；白品种 Encruzado、Rabo-de-Ovelha、Douradinha、Tamarez / Molinha。官方另以整页介绍 Touriga Nacional（"É uma das mais cosmopolitas castas portuguesas [...] produz vinhos com uma cor tinto intenso, aroma a frutos pretos muito maduros"）与 Rabo-de-Ovelha（"É uma casta bastante produtiva [...] Origina vinhos de cor citrina, ligeiramente frutados, equilibrados e neutros"）。
data.soil: 官方原文（Terroir 页）："As vinhas estão instaladas em terrenos de baixa fertilidade, predominantemente graníticos com diversos afloramentos xistosos que surgem a sul e a poente da Região."（低肥力、以花岗岩为主，南部与西部有片岩露头）。
data.climate: 官方原文（Terroir 页）："O clima, não obstante ser temperado, é frio e chuvoso no Inverno e muito quente e seco no Verão, contudo há muitas variações microclimáticas de grande importância para a qualidade dos vinhos, onde se enquadram as sub-regiões de Alva, Besteiros, Castendo, Serra da Estrela, Silgueiros, Terras de Azurara e Terras de Senhorim." 同页气候标签 "Clima Temperado: Rígido e chuvoso no inverno e muito quente no verão."
data.geography: 官方原文（Terroir 页）："Ainda que se encontre implantada em altitudes que rondam os 800 metros, é entre os 400 – 500 que vegeta em maior quantidade."；"A rede hidrográfica da Região caracteriza-se por um traçado rígido [...] os três principais rios da região – O Dão, o Mondego e o Alva – cujos cursos apresentam um grande paralelismo enquanto percorrem todo o maciço granítico."
data.notes: 官方原文（Região Demarcada 页）："Em 18 de Setembro de 1908, uma Carta de Lei estabelece formalmente a Região Demarcada do Dão. O regulamento para a produção e comercialização dos vinhos aí produzidos surge dois anos volvidos, em 25 de Maio de 1910, com o Decreto regulamentador. Com esta decisão, o Dão tornou-se a primeira região de vinhos não licorosos a ser demarcada e regulamentada no nosso país."（1908-09-18 立法设区，1910-05-25 出规范，为葡萄牙首个被划界并立规的非加强酒产区）。同页亦述 20 世纪 60–70 年代因重产量轻质量而衰落、此后以新技术与创业精神重振。
data.officialQuote: Em 18 de Setembro de 1908, uma Carta de Lei estabelece formalmente a Região Demarcada do Dão. [...] Com esta decisão, o Dão tornou-se a primeira região de vinhos não licorosos a ser demarcada e regulamentada no nosso país.

en.name: Paso Robles
en.description: California Central Coast AVA with 11 sub-AVAs, Mediterranean climate (Winkler regions II–IV), over 200 wineries and 40,000 acres of grapes across 60+ varieties led by Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah, Grenache and Mourvèdre.
en.sourceTitle: Paso Robles Wine Country Alliance — Wineries by AVA（英文官方页）

data.areaNote: 官方原文（Wineries by AVA 页）："More than 200 wineries dot the landscape, sourcing fruit from 40,000 acres of wine grapes that vary from Albariño to Zinfandel."（4 万英亩≈16 187 ha，为约数且以英亩表述，官方未给公顷数）。另有 "Over 60 different varietals are grown in the Paso Robles region." 因官方以英亩约数表述且未给精确统计年，本轮不换算成公顷写入 areaHectares，面积留 null、原文照录于此。
data.productionNote: 协会官网本次抓取的页面未公布产量数字（无 hl/吨口径），留空。
data.producersNote: 官方原文（Wineries by AVA 页）："More than 200 wineries dot the landscape"（逾 200 家酒庄）。协会另设 /wineries/ 与 /visit/wineries/ 会员名录（按子 AVA、接待类型、是否有餐饮/旅游体验等标签筛选）。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Wineries by AVA 页）："Over 60 different varietals are grown in the Paso Robles region. The majority being Cabernet Sauvignon, followed by Merlot, Syrah and other red varieties like Grenache and Mourvèdre."；首页订阅表单的 FAVORITE VARIETY 选项另列 Albariño、Cabernet Franc、Chardonnay、Grenache Blanc、Malbec、Petite Sirah、Pinot Grigio、Pinot Noir、Roussanne、Sangiovese、Sauvignon Blanc、Tempranillo、Viognier、Zinfandel、Rosé、Sparkling、Port-Style。
data.soil: 官方原文（Wineries by AVA 页）："Paso's exceptional climate, proximity to the Pacific Ocean, varying topography, and diversity of soils make it a great place to produce world class wines."（未给出具体成土类型列表，仅称土壤多样性）；同页按子 AVA 给出 Topography 段落（如 Adelaida District 起首为 "Santa Lucia Ra…"）。
data.climate: 官方原文（Wineries by AVA 页）："The Paso Robles American Viticulture Area is situated along California's Central Coast. Framed by two mountain ranges, the region enjoys a Mediterranean climate with warm days and cool nights."；"Paso Robles has a maritime climate becoming more continental to the east"，同页给出 growing degree-day 分区 "REGION(S) II, III and IV."（Winkler 积温区 II、III、IV）。另有 "8 – 30"、"20 – 50" 两组官方数值（页面未带单位标签，本次不判定其含义，故不引用）。
data.geography: 官方原文（About Paso Robles 页）："Halfway between the two main California metropolises of Los Angeles and San Francisco is Paso Robles Wine Country. Located along California's famed Central Coast [...] A long growing season of warm days and cool evenings gives rise to vibrantly ripened fruit"；"The 11 viticultural areas of Paso Robles demonstrate the diversity of Paso Robles Wine Country"（11 个子产区）。
data.notes: AVA 设立年份未在本次可抓取官方页给出（协会站叙述历史但未给联邦定界年份；官方另有 AVA Map 下载与 /paso-robles/ 页）。appellationCreated 留 null。11 个子 AVA 名称取自官方 Wineries by AVA 页与博客按子产区分类条目（Adelaida、Creston、El Pomar、Estrella、Geneseo、Highlands、Willow Creek、San Juan Creek、San Miguel、Santa Margarita Ranch、Templeton Gap）；页面排版中有 "Paso Robles Highlands" 与 "Santa Margarita District"/"Santa Margarita Ranch AVA" 等混写，已按官方博客分类所见的规范名写入。
data.officialQuote: The Paso Robles American Viticulture Area is situated along California's Central Coast. Framed by two mountain ranges, the region enjoys a Mediterranean climate with warm days and cool nights. More than 200 wineries dot the landscape, sourcing fruit from 40,000 acres of wine grapes that vary from Albariño to Zinfandel.

producerDirectory.name: Paso Robles Wine Country Alliance — Wineries / Visit Wineries（会员名录，按子 AVA 与标签筛选）
producerDirectory.note: 协会官方会员名录，支持按子 AVA（如 Downtown & Tin City、Highly Acclaimed、Family Friendly、Onsite Dining、Tours & Experiences、Vast Views、ROC Certified）等标签筛选，会员条目带数字 id（如 members=3605%2C3607…）；条目为前端渲染，本次未逐家解析联系地址字段。规模取官方文字口径「逾 200 家酒庄」。 （会员详情页 /member/<slug>/ 给出地址、营业时间与官网）

es.name: Valle del Itata
es.description: Uno de los valles vitivinícolas más antiguos de Chile, con más de 500 años de historia, ubicado en la Región del Bío-Bío, provincia de Ñuble; clima mediterráneo húmedo con temperaturas más bajas que otros valles y suelos graníticos arenosos ricos en minerales; variedades tradicionales País y Moscatel de Alejandría.
es.sourceTitle: Vinos de Chile — Regiones Vitivinícolas（官方页，西语版为 /es/winegrowing-regions/）

data.areaNote: Vinos de Chile（Wines of Chile）官方产区页本次未给出 Itata 谷的葡萄园公顷数（官方数字在年报/统计页与 SAG 报告内），SAG 站点本次抓到的为首页与新闻列表，亦无该谷面积，故 areaHectares 留 null。
data.productionNote: 官方未在本次抓取页面公布 Itata 产量数字。SAG 官方站有葡萄酒产量新闻（如 /noticias/ 下的产量报告），本次未逐条解析，故产量留空。
data.producersNote: Vinos de Chile 官方产区页未给 Itata 逐家生产者家数，也未列名录；官方另设成员名录页（/members/）与 SAG 登记体系，本次未解析出 Itata 范围的生产者计数，故留空。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Vinos de Chile 英文产区页 Itata 段）："traditional varieties such as País and Moscatel de Alejandría, that pred[ominate]"（传统品种以 País 与 Moscatel de Alejandría 为主）。官方品种词条另单列 CINSAULT（"Still one of the most produced varieties worldwide, this fruity red with a smooth texture is extremely easy to drink. Hailing from the Bordeaux region, it made its way to Chile in the mid-19th century, but was not truly popular until the early 1990s."）与 PAÍS 两个条目。
data.soil: 官方原文（Vinos de Chile 英文产区页 Itata 段）："sandy granitic soils rich in minerals"（富含矿物质的砂质花岗岩土壤）。
data.climate: 官方原文（Vinos de Chile 英文产区页 Itata 段）："Its humid Mediterranean climate, the presence of lower temperatures compared to in other valleys, well-differentiated seasons [...]"（湿润的地中海气候、较其他谷更低的温度、季节分明）。
data.geography: 官方原文（Vinos de Chile 英文产区页 Itata 段）："With more than 500 years of history, the Itata Valley, one of the oldest wine-growing areas in the country and whose name means 'abundant pastures' in Mapudungun, as it was the Mapuches who inhabited the area before the arrival of the conquistadores. It is geographically located in the Bío-Bío region, in the province of Ñuble."（逾 500 年历史、智利最古老葡萄种植区之一、名称在马普切语中意为「丰茂的牧场」、位于 Bío-Bío 大区 Ñuble 省）。
data.notes: 法定产区（Denominación de Origen）设立年份未在本次可抓取官方页给出，appellationCreated 留 null。Itata 的老藤 País（Criolla 系）为该区特色，本次在官方产区页确认为「传统品种」，但未取得老藤面积或藤龄的数字口径。
data.officialQuote: With more than 500 years of history, the Itata Valley, one of the oldest wine-growing areas in the country and whose name means “abundant pastures” in Mapudungun [...] It is geographically located in the Bío-Bío region, in the province of Ñuble. Its humid Mediterranean climate, the presence of lower temperatures compared to in other valleys, well-differentiated seasons and sandy granitic soils rich in minerals, are what give rise to high productivity and favour the growth of traditional varieties such as País and Moscatel de Alejandría

en.name: Hunter Valley
en.description: Australia's oldest wine region (first plots in the early 1820s, over 500 acres by 1840), celebrated for world-class Semillon with 10+ year ageing, medium-bodied old-vine Shiraz, and Chardonnay; also Verdelho plus newer Tempranillo and Sangiovese plantings.
en.sourceTitle: Hunter Valley Wine Country — Wine Styles / History（英文官方页）

data.areaNote: Hunter Valley Wine & Tourism Association（HVWTA）官方站在本次抓取的 Wine / History / Wine Styles / Sustainability / Cellar Doors 页均未公布 GI 葡萄园公顷数或产量，故 areaHectares 与产量均留 null（不引用未核实数字）。
data.productionNote: 协会官网本次抓取页面未公布产量数字（无 hl/吨口径），留空。
data.producersNote: 协会官网「Cellar Doors」名录页原文仅作叙述："From big-name wineries to boutique beauties hidden away down country back roads, the Hunter Valley has enough cellar doors to keep you coming back time after time."（未给出家数）。可核实的规模数字来自官方博客的活动报道："The 54th Show attracted 69 exhibitors and 652 entries"（2026 年葡萄酒展 69 家参展商、652 款参赛酒）。协会名录页为前端渲染，逐家条目本次未解析出。
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Wine Styles 页）："our iconic Semillon is the World's best"、"our highly prized old-vine Shiraz has set an enduring benchmark for quality Australian wines and we lay claim to being the birthplace of classy Chardonnay"；品种专节 SEMILLON（"Hunter Valley Semillon has lemon and lime flavours, citrusy crispness and a natural, lively acid"，可陈年 "10 years plus easily"）、SHIRAZ（"Hunter Valley Shiraz is medium bodied, savoury and food friendly"）、CHARDONNAY（"Flavours tend to be white peach and citrus, with a slatey acid"）、VERDELHO（"Flavours are bold and lively – a fruit salad in a glass"）、ALTERNATIVE VARIETALS（"Tempranillo, the top red of Spain is showing great potential. Sangiovese, that savoury Italian red [...]"）。
data.agingNote: 官方原文（Semillon 节）："It can be enjoyed as a youngster on a hot day, or you can take advantage of its wonderful ageing potential – 10 years plus easily. With age you get honeyed flavours and some toasty notes."；Shiraz 节："history has shown time and again that Hunter Valley Shiraz can age for decades"。
data.soil: 官方历史页给出与土壤相关的地形线索（"the Northern banks of the Hunter River trade route"、"the surrounding hill country"）；Wine Styles 页称 Semillon "thriving in the Hunter, especially in those dried up, sandy river beds"（干涸的砂质河床）。协会官网未设独立成土专页，本次未取到可引用的成土原句，留待复核。
data.climate: 协会官网设有独立 Weather & Climate 页与 Know Before You Go 页（本次未逐页抓取），Wine / Wine Styles 页未给出气候数字原句，故 climate 不做数字断言。官方 Sustainability 页自述 "We've made firm commitments to organic growing, biodynamic methods and carbon neutral certification."
data.geography: 官方原文（History 页）："The valley's first small vineyard plots of about 20 acres were planted on the Northern banks of the Hunter River trade route in the early 1820's. Australia's first families of wine soon branched out into the surrounding hill country with more than 500 acres of vines and by the roaring '20s, had become the bastion of premium wine production."；"James Busby, introduced to the Hunter region around 500 vine cuttings sourced from collections and private plantings in South America and Europe, including several cuttings of Syrah from the Hermitage hill in the Rhône region of South France."；"By 1840, the registered vineyard area in the Hunter Valley had expanded to over 500 acres."；Wine 页称 "Nearly 200 years later"，并称该地是澳大利亚葡萄种植与酿酒的发源地（"where great Australian grape growing and winemaking all began"）。
data.notes: GI（Geographical Indication）注册年份未在本次可抓取官方页给出，appellationCreated 留 null。先驱酒庄家族：官方列出 Dr. Henry Lindeman 与 Drayton's、Tulloch's、Tyrrell's、Wilkinson's 四家（"He was joined by four prominent wine families"）。子产区名（Pokolbin、Broke Fordwich、Lovedale、Around Hermitage）取自官方站导航与博客分类（博客条目按 Pokolbin / Broke / Lovedale / Around Hermitage 分类），非本次从法定 GI 文本取得，标注为待复核口径。
data.officialQuote: Here in the Hunter Valley, we don't make wines en masse. We value quality and character over volume and it shines through in the many extraordinary wines unique to our region. Awarded by the world's top wine judges and enjoyed by wine lovers across the world, our iconic Semillon is the World's best.

en.name: Martinborough
en.description: Southernmost subregion of the Wairarapa GI on New Zealand's North Island: vines first planted 1883, modern era from the late 1970s; Burgundy-like climate and soils, free-draining soils, cool dry climate; acclaimed Pinot Noir plus Sauvignon Blanc, Syrah, aromatics and Pinot Gris.
en.sourceTitle: New Zealand Winegrowers — Wairarapa（英文官方页）

data.areaNote: New Zealand Winegrowers（nzwine.com）官方站在本次抓取的 Wairarapa 产区页、Geographical Indications 页、Regional/Sub-regional Associations 页均未给出 Martinborough 或 Wairarapa 的葡萄园公顷数（官方统计数字在 /media/statistics-reports/ 与年报中，本次未解析），故 areaHectares 留 null。
data.productionNote: 官方未在本次抓取页面公布产量数字，留空。
data.producersNote: 官方原文（Wairarapa 页）："Wairarapa (meaning glistening waters in Maori) is a compact yet diverse region, with numerous boutique producers offering a range of varieties"；"With a fascinating early settler history, vines were first planted in 1883 but fell victim to the temperance movement in 1905. Wairarapa's modern wine history dates from the late 1970s and the region boasts some of New Zealand's most iconic and sought after producers."（未给家数）。全国口径可引用官方原文："New Zealand Winegrowers is the national organisation for the country's grape and wine sector, with over 600 grower members and 700 winery members."
data.grapeNote: 官方原文（Wairarapa 页）："A range of styles and varieties are on offer with standout Pinot Noir, Sauvignon Blanc and Aromatics as well as stylish Chardonnay, Syrah and dessert wines."；页面亦单列 "Pinot Gris"、"Pinot Noir" 两个品种标签，并称 "The region's flagship red; richly flavoured and warm with a savoury undercurrent whilst retaining perfumed varietal character, Wairarapa Pinots offer texture and depth."；"Pinot Gris is successful with the long growing season also allowing for late harvest and botrytised styles."
data.soil: 官方原文（Wairarapa 页）："With a climate and soil profile similar to that of Burgundy, it's no wonder that Martinborough has excited the wine world."；Martinborough 子产区 "boasts free-draining soils and a cool, dry climate"；Gladstone 子产区 "blessed with free-draining river terraces and a cooler climate with plenty of sunshine. Clay amongst the stony silt loams suits the predominant Pinot Noir very well"；Masterton 子产区 "The valley is shadowed by the Tararua ranges, and early morning frosts are common, contrasted by incredible hot summer days."
data.climate: 官方原文（Wairarapa 页）："Our temperate maritime climate allows a wide range of wine varieties to flourish."；Martinborough 子产区 "a cool, dry climate"；Masterton "This diurnal range produces complex and flavourful wines"。
data.geography: 官方原文（Wairarapa 页）："The three main subregions share broadly similar climate and soils yet also offer subtle differences in character for the discerning palate to explore."（三个子产区：Masterton、Gladstone、Martinborough）。Martinborough 被描述为 "This picturesque colonial village is surrounded by small vineyards, tended by family-owned producers"，是 Wairarapa 最南的子产区（"this most southerly Wairarapa subregion"）。
data.notes: 官方把 Martinborough 置于 Wairarapa 产区之下作为子产区（subregion）叙述，而非独立的 GI 页；Martinborough GI 的注册年份未在本次可抓取官方页给出，appellationCreated 留 null。官方另有 Wairarapa Wine Association、Wairarapa wine map 与 Toast Martinborough 活动入口（"Wairarapa wine events [...] the famous Toast Martinborough"）。Martinborough 本地推广站 martinboroughwine.co.nz 本次 DNS 解析失败（curl 000），产区口径以 NZ Winegrowers 为准。
data.officialQuote: With a climate and soil profile similar to that of Burgundy, it's no wonder that Martinborough has excited the wine world. Acclaimed Pinot Noir, vivid Sauvignon Blanc, and elegant aromatics and Syrah are all produced in this most southerly Wairarapa subregion, which boasts free-draining soils and a cool, dry climate.

name: 汝拉

data.name: 汝拉
data.sourceTitle: CIVJ 汝拉葡萄酒跨行业委员会 / INAO
data.notes: 法国东部、勃艮第与瑞士之间的独立葡萄酒产区，行政上属勃艮第-弗朗什-孔泰大区汝拉省。葡萄园约 1,900–2,100 ha，海拔 250–400 m，呈约 10 km 宽、80 km 长的南北条带（北起 Arc-et-Senans）。石灰岩与泥灰岩土壤。以 Vin Jaune（黄酒）、Vin de Paille（稻草酒）与 Savagnin 品种闻名。
data.geography: ★ 汝拉是**独立的葡萄酒大区**，与勃艮第**产区体系互不隶属**（两者仅在同一行政大区 Bourgogne-Franche-Comté 下共处）。它有自己的跨行业机构 CIVJ 与独立的 AOC 体系。
data.doStructure: 官方法定 AOC 分为「4 个地理 AOC + 3 个产品 AOC」：地理 AOC 为 Arbois、Côtes du Jura、Château-Chalon、L'Étoile；产品 AOC 为 Crémant du Jura、Macvin du Jura、Marc du Jura。★ 注意 Vin Jaune 与 Vin de Paille **不是独立 AOC**，而是挂在上述地理 AOC 下的「风格 / 传统标注」（Vin Jaune 可标于 Arbois / Côtes du Jura / L'Étoile / Château-Chalon；Vin de Paille 可标于 Côtes du Jura / Arbois / L'Étoile）。
subzones: Arbois（含 Arbois-Pupillin；汝拉最大 AOC，1936-05-15 确认）
Côtes du Jura（南北贯穿全区的 AOC，1937 确认，覆盖约 105 市镇）
Château-Chalon（仅 Savagnin、仅产 Vin Jaune，约 4 市镇）
L'Étoile（以优质白葡萄酒著称，约 4 市镇）
data.locationPrecision: 参考点：汝拉葡萄园条带中部的近似中心。★ 这不是法定边界，也不代表产区范围；法定几何待核。

name: 奥克地区

data.name: 奥克地区
data.sourceTitle: IGP Pays d'Oc 官方站（paysdoc-wines.com）
data.notes: 法国**最大的 IGP**：葡萄园约 120,000 ha（占朗格多克-鲁西荣约一半），年产约 550–680 万 hl（随年份波动），约 7.43 亿瓶、48% 出口，年营收 36 亿欧元。法定品种 58 个。930 家独立酒庄 + 150 家合作社 + 1,200 名独立种植者。
data.geography: 覆盖法国南部奥克西塔尼大区（Occitanie）的 4 个省——奥德省（Aude）、加尔省（Gard）、埃罗省（Hérault）、东比利牛斯省（Pyrénées-Orientales，即鲁西荣），另加洛泽尔省（Lozère）的 6 个市镇（Ispagnac、La Malène、Les Vignes、Montbrun、Quézac、Sainte-Enimie）。
data.doStructure: ★ 级别为 **IGP（Indication Géographique Protégée）**，**不是 AOC/AOP**。前身为 1987 年创立的「Vin de Pays d'Oc」（奥克地区餐酒）；2009-08-01 欧盟共同市场组织改革后改为 IGP 并归 INAO 管辖，2010 年份起正式使用「IGP Pays d'Oc」。在法国 75 个 IGP 的三层结构（7 个大区级 / 28 个省级 / 41 个小产区）中，它是**大区级（régional）**，地理上**跨省但同属奥克西塔尼一个大区**。
data.locationPrecision: 参考点：奥克西塔尼大区葡萄种植带的近似中心。★ 这不是法定边界；IGP 范围以 cahier des charges 为准，几何待核。
data.hierarchyNote: 2026-09-29 由顶层降为 southern-france 之下（IGP 非地理大区）。

name: 伊犁河谷

data.name: 伊犁河谷
data.sourceTitle: 新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府《新疆维吾尔自治区葡萄酒产业"十四五"发展规划》
data.notes: 新疆四大葡萄酒产区之一（官方「4+2」格局），位于天山以北的伊犁河谷。官方规划口径：「伊犁河谷产区主要包括伊犁州直和兵团第四师 62 团、63 团、67 团及 70 团」。核心种植区为可克达拉市/察布查尔锡伯自治县（67 团，面积最大）、霍尔果斯市/霍城县（62 团）、伊宁市（70 团）。2021 年有葡萄酒企业 15 家（占全疆 9.7%）。
data.geography: ★ 与焉耆盆地产区**完全独立、互不重叠**：两地分别位于伊犁哈萨克自治州与巴音郭楞蒙古自治州，被天山山脉隔开（伊犁河谷在西天山以北、伊犁河上游；焉耆盆地在天山中段南麓、博斯腾湖流域），地理上不接壤。
data.doStructure: ★ **无葡萄酒地理标志**。经核新疆地理标志保护产品名录（2021 年度年报）与 2023 年知识产权保护状况白皮书，全疆葡萄酒类 GI 仅有「吐鲁番葡萄酒」与「和硕葡萄酒」两项（2015 年第 143 号公告），伊犁河谷不在其中。另有「伊犁酒」GI，但那是**白酒/蒸馏酒**（用标企业为伊犁肖尔布拉克酒业），与葡萄酒无关；霍城县的「莫乎尔葡萄」农产品地标则是**鲜食葡萄**。故本产区身份为「自治区官方规划的行业产区」，非法定 GI。
subzones: 可克达拉市 / 察布查尔锡伯自治县（67 团，河谷南岸，面积最大）
霍尔果斯市 / 霍城县（62 团，河谷北岸）
data.locationPrecision: 参考点：伊犁河谷中心。★ 这不是法定边界，也不代表产区范围；本图鉴边界为「所涉县级行政区划兜底」。
